tactical_analysis.headline: Defensive Mastery and Tactical Supremacy: A Comprehensive Analysis of Super Bowl LX
tactical_analysis.narrative_summary: The narrative of Super Bowl LX, held on February 8, 2026, at Levi's Stadium, was defined by the relentless defensive architecture of the Seattle Seahawks. In a decisive 29-13 victory over the New England Patriots, Mike Macdonald’s 'Dark Side' defense delivered a historic performance, shutting out the Patriots for three full quarters and stifling an offense that had been prolific throughout the postseason.

historic_facts.description: With New England trailing 9-0 at halftime, Super Bowl history held firm; teams that are held scoreless in the first half are now 0-15 all-time in the Super Bowl.
historic_facts.title: The Post-Half Curse

historic_facts.description: The Seahawks became the first Super Bowl champion in NFL history to complete an entire postseason run without committing a single turnover.
historic_facts.title: The Perfect Champion

historic_facts.description: New England was 0-for-2 in red zone opportunities during the competitive phases of the game, forced into 6 punts and 2 turnovers.
historic_facts.title: Red Zone Suffocation

historic_facts.description: Seattle generated a 48.6% pressure rate while rushing 5 or more defenders on only 14% of snaps.
historic_facts.title: Pressure Rate Without Blitzing

bullets.detail: Generated 6 sacks, 21 pressures, 2 forced fumbles, and an interception while holding NE to 218 total yards.
bullets.label: Statistical Impact

bullets.detail: Held New England to 2-of-13 on third down conversions.
bullets.label: Third Down Lockdown

bullets.detail: Mafe beat the right tackle with an inside spin move to strip the football, leading directly to a Seattle touchdown.
bullets.label: Strip-Sack Climax

bullets.detail: Targeted 5 times, allowing only 1 catch for 4 yards with 2 pass breakups in man coverage.
bullets.label: Island Lockdown

bullets.detail: 135 rushing yards on 22 carries (6.1 YPC) with 2 touchdowns, chewing up clock throughout the second half.
bullets.label: Ground Domination

tactical_dos_donts.logic: Confused the young quarterback by showing blitz with 6 men at the line of scrimmage then dropping two into underneath flats.
tactical_dos_donts.strategy: Disguise Pre-Snap Cover-3 Match with Simulated Creepers

tactical_dos_donts.logic: Allowed Kenneth Walker cutback lanes against an aggressive front, racking up 135 rushing yards.
tactical_dos_donts.strategy: Establish Outside Zone Stretch to Tire Opposing Linebackers

tactical_dos_donts.logic: Patriots surrendered 4 sacks on 7 play-action attempts due to rapid edge penetration by Seattle.
tactical_dos_donts.strategy: Call Slow-Developing Play-Action in Obvious Pass Situations

tactical_dos_donts.logic: Resulted in 2 pass breakups and an incomplete 4th-down attempt.
tactical_dos_donts.strategy: Challenge Devon Witherspoon on Boundary Fades Without Leverage
